title: 又過一天，又賺一份工錢
titleZh: 又過一天，又賺一份工錢
imageAlt: Illustrated learning card for Another Day, Another Dollar.
imageAltZh: 「又過一天，又賺一份工錢」學習插圖。

source.reference: Oxford proverb index; original teaching scenes and questions

meaning.en: A wry or weary comment on another ordinary day of work undertaken to earn a living.
meaning.zh: 又完成了一天例行工作，賺取生活所需；語氣常帶疲倦或無奈。

examples.en: After another nearly identical shift, Long packed up his tools and said, “Another day, another dollar.”
examples.zh: 阿朗又做完一班幾乎一模一樣的工作，收好工具後苦笑了一下。

instructions.en: Choose the one sentence that keeps the situation’s facts and uses “another day, another dollar” accurately.
instructions.zh: 選出唯一保留情境事實、又正確使用「another day, another dollar」的英文句子。

questions.prompt: Long finishes another nearly identical shift stocking shelves and gives a wry smile.
questions.promptZh: 阿朗做完又一班幾乎相同的貨架整理工作，收工時苦笑。
questions.answer: Long finishes another familiar shift with a weary smile—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿朗做完又一班幾乎相同的貨架整理工作，收工時苦笑。

questions.prompt: Min completes the daily cleaning again, puts away her tools, and sighs softly.
questions.promptZh: 阿敏再次完成每日的清潔工作，把工具收好後輕輕嘆氣。
questions.answer: Min reaches the end of another routine working day—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿敏再次完成每日的清潔工作，把工具收好後輕輕嘆氣。

questions.prompt: Jun checks orders by the same process for a third day and jokes, “Here we go again.”
questions.promptZh: 阿俊連續第三天按同一流程核對訂單，笑說「又來了」。
questions.answer: Jun is facing another similar day of paid work—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿俊連續第三天按同一流程核對訂單，笑說「又來了」。

questions.prompt: Sze locks the shop and remarks that she will open it at the same hour tomorrow.
questions.promptZh: 阿詩關掉店裏的燈，說明天又要按一樣的時間開門。
questions.answer: Sze expects another familiar working day tomorrow—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿詩關掉店裏的燈，說明天又要按一樣的時間開門。

questions.prompt: Bin puts down today’s delivery sheet, sees another pile for tomorrow, and shakes his head wryly.
questions.promptZh: 阿彬把今天的派送單放下，望着明天一疊相同表格，半開玩笑地搖頭。
questions.answer: Bin sees another ordinary shift waiting for him—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿彬把今天的派送單放下，望着明天一疊相同表格，半開玩笑地搖頭。

questions.prompt: Wai finishes another day answering similar enquiries and says the days blur together.
questions.promptZh: 阿慧完成又一天接聽同類查詢的工作，下班時說日子真相似。
questions.answer: Wai comments on the sameness of her working days—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿慧完成又一天接聽同類查詢的工作，下班時說日子真相似。

questions.prompt: Ki follows the same mail route each day and smiles tiredly when he returns to the post office.
questions.promptZh: 阿其每天按相同路線收信，今天回到郵局後疲倦地笑。
questions.answer: Ki completes another routine mail round—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿其每天按相同路線收信，今天回到郵局後疲倦地笑。

questions.prompt: Lin finishes another evening shift and says on the way home, “Same again tomorrow.”
questions.promptZh: 阿蓮又按時完成一班晚更，回家路上只說「明天照樣」。
questions.answer: Lin expects another similar shift after this one—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿蓮又按時完成一班晚更，回家路上只說「明天照樣」。

questions.prompt: Lam arranges the bakery stock each day and finishes the same task today before saying, “Done.”
questions.promptZh: 阿霖每天排好麵包店的貨，今天也照常做完，拍拍手套說「收工」。
questions.answer: Lam has completed another ordinary paid day—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿霖每天排好麵包店的貨，今天也照常做完，拍拍手套說「收工」。

questions.prompt: Jay enters another batch of data, sees tomorrow’s similar list, and smiles wryly.
questions.promptZh: 阿傑把又一批資料輸入系統，望着明天的同類清單苦笑。
questions.answer: Jay faces the familiar cycle of another workday—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿傑把又一批資料輸入系統，望着明天的同類清單苦笑。

questions.prompt: Ana finishes the regular Monday stocktake and says the same task will return next week.
questions.promptZh: 阿娜完成固定的週一盤點，說下星期又會重來。
questions.answer: Ana wryly notes another cycle of routine work—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿娜完成固定的週一盤點，說下星期又會重來。

questions.prompt: Ming packs away his repair tools after another day of similar repairs and sighs calmly.
questions.promptZh: 阿明收好修理工具，結束又一天相似的維修工作，平靜地嘆口氣。
questions.answer: Ming reflects on another workday much like the last—another day, another dollar.
questions.answerZh: 阿明收好修理工具，結束又一天相似的維修工作，平靜地嘆口氣。
